method: Headless Chrome, built production application served by npm run preview at 127.0.0.1:8002. Intercept actual WebGL2 draw calls and read bound single-sample HalfFloat framebuffers using the GPU implementation read type. No source-only shader surrogate.
preExposure: gain = flashStrength * referenceDuration / shutter; scale = 1 / (1 + gain). Apply to static plate and ordinary live material outputs before first HalfFloat write. Preserve scale through lens/temporal/pulse buffers. Restore scene units at final photographic exposure; meter restores scene units too.

actualSource.ambient: Black substituted ambient plate only, to isolate the actual unmodified flash layer

strongFixture.description: Constant transport WebP encoded with the real flash log2 encoding; quantized decoded level about 4715, substantially above the old 16-radiance fixture

liveFan.description: Real production geometry/materials and camera-mounted PointLight. Black ambient plate, black room flash, black HDR environment and zero area-light intensities isolate the fan pulse. All live mesh shaders receive the same scale.

existingRegression: 7/7 production HDR/lens/layer tests passed in 21.1 s, plus the added legacy Scene Color production regression passed in 4.6 s (8 checks total).
limits: HalfFloat quantization remains; this is reversible pre-exposure, not clipping or a change to the flash teaching model. Single-depth optical approximation and bounded motion sample limitations are unchanged.

legacyBackground.description: Production camera-only glTF fixture verifies directly cleared Scene Color, which bypasses material shaders, receives matching pre-exposure. Same aperture/ISO/shutter, flash off/on.
